title: Speed
description: Host Sean Riley charts a course into the wild blue yonder to look back at the original challenges of air travel and forecast what's next in aviation.

title: Strange Planes
description: It was the thick of WWII and Allies needed a way to get behind enemy lines; it would take an advanced flying machine to get this job done, pushing the limits of rotary flight; see how a regular Jeep utility vehicle was transformed into the Flying Jeep.

title: NASA Explorers
description: The OSIRIS-REx team launches a spacecraft to an asteroid to collect a sample of Bennu.

title: Strange Planes
description: During World War I, several new innovations emerged on the battlefield and proved crucial to breaking the stalemate of trench warfare; high on the list was the tank and the airplane; almost as soon as those two inventions entered the war, military planners and engineers endeavor ways to combine the two and create a mega-weapon, The Flying Tank.

title: NASA Explorers
description: When it comes to space exploration, expect the unexpected. As OSIRIS-REx approached asteroid Bennu, scientists were surprised to find a loosely packed rubble pile. This week, we get a closer look at Bennu and the surprises it holds in store.
